name: Higgs Boson Event Confidence Interval Estimation
description: The task involves estimating the confidence interval for the signal strength (µ) of Higgs boson events in simulated proton-proton collision datasets, incorporating both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties.

cr:input.name: FAIR Universe HiggsML Dataset
cr:input.description: A tabular dataset of 280 million simulated proton-proton collision events, with 28 features representing primary attributes (e.g., energy, momentum) and derived attributes. Each instance is labeled as either a Higgs boson event or a background event.
cr:input.contentUrl: https://zenodo.org/record/[FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset download URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The output is a 68.27% confidence interval (CI) for the signal strength (µ), represented as two bounds: µ16 and µ84.

field.name: µ16
field.description: Lower bound of the 68.27% confidence interval for the signal strength µ. Example: 0.8

field.name: µ84
field.description: Upper bound of the 68.27% confidence interval for the signal strength µ. Example: 1.2

cr:evaluation.notes: Quantile Score is calculated as -ln((w + ϵ)f(c)), where w is the average width of the confidence interval, c is the coverage, and ϵ = 10^-2 is a regularization term. The penalising function f penalizes deviations from the expected 68.27% coverage, with asymmetric penalties for overestimation and underestimation.
